title: Fixed Rope Laced Open Foot Goblet Drum
description: One newly authored complete static rope-laced goblet hand-drum appearance. A single continuous thick shell narrows from the broad upper chamber into a waisted stem and flares into its own genuinely open annular ground foot; the internal channel runs through the waist to the open underside. A complete finite-thickness upper head closes the chamber above. One full upper lacing/head hoop and one narrow waist hoop anchor twelve entire triangular rope loops outside the tapered body. This is not an old drum kit cylinder reshaped by scale or a copper kettle lifted onto a stand: the full continuous open-foot goblet volume and hoop-to-waist rope routing are newly authored together, with no old geometry imports. Three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One model and zero scenes. Fixed visual display only: no playable sound, tuning, membrane vibration, rope tension, acoustic performance, traditional construction authenticity, physical stability, manufacture or safety claim.
